title: Leviathan Falls
author: James S. A. Corey
summary: The ninth and final Expanse novel. Humanity has spread across hundreds of worlds while a mysterious force threatens it from beyond, and the crew of the Rocinante and their allies face the last stand of the series.
readIf: you have followed the Expanse series and want its conclusion.
skipIf: you have not read the series, as this is the final book and would spoil a lot.

pairings.reason: A big-scale science-fiction story about how species meet, adapt and survive across vast time.
Equally concerned with a vast, unknowable threat and with how humans respond.
Another far-future space story that cares about empire, loyalty and identity.
